headline: One o'clock. Wind holds the cloud.
body: Fifteen degrees under mostly cloudy skies, wind from the west near twenty-one with gusts past forty. Pavements remain dry while the near lanes carry their early-afternoon load. The sun sits high but soft behind the unbroken cover.
